name: Monet
description: Open-source shared memory platform for AI agent teams. Provides persistent memory across sessions with native MCP support, multi-tenant isolation, semantic search, and dashboard UI for memory inspection.
community_quotes: Open-source shared memory for AI agent teams
Memories persist and are searchable across sessions
Agents inherit accumulated team knowledge from day one
Native MCP support with multi-tenant isolation

name: broccoli
description: Workflow orchestration agent that turns Linear tickets into shipped PRs. Powered by Claude and Codex, running on Google Cloud Run with optional Blaxel sandbox execution. Features automated PR code review and production-grade serverless architecture.
community_quotes: Linear tickets into shipped PRs while you sleep
One of the biggest issues with coding agents is context drift - ticket says one thing but codebase has changed
It's worked really well for both feature development and bug hunting
Helps keep us honest with tickets - good LLM context is still good human context

name: kimiflare
description: Terminal-native coding agent running on Kimi K2.6 via Cloudflare Workers AI. Features multi-turn tool use, 262k context, vision inputs, and full agentic loop with transparent operations.
community_quotes: Open-source claude code / kimi code clone that uses kimi k2.6 using cloudflare workers AI
Cheaper per token than most hosted coding assistants and fully transparent about what it's doing
Multi-turn tool use, 262k context, vision inputs, full agentic loop
